title: search: IndexWriter lock held during commit, serializes concurrent posts
description: Lines 207-211 in crates/reader/src/search/mod.rs hold the tokio::sync::Mutex lock while calling commit(), which may block for I/O. In the POST pipeline (lifecycle.rs:617), each post indexes articles then commits, holding the lock for the entire duration. With concurrent POSTs, this serializes all commits and can cause latency spikes. Lock should be released before or during commit, or commit should be batched outside the lock.
